name: SIQ - FC Fly-In
description: Eye-catching featured collection section where products fly into view with a staggered scroll-triggered animation. Products animate into the grid when the section enters the viewport, creating a dynamic entrance effect. Supports stacked grid and carousel layouts, configurable columns, product count, image aspect ratios, content alignment, and a CTA button. The fly-in animation only triggers on desktop for optimal performance. Includes full section spacing controls and color scheme support. Perfect for highlighting curated collections with a modern, engaging feel.
author: SectionIQ
